occupancy_room_capacity.name: occupancy_room_capacity
occupancy_room_capacity.value: ("occupancy_rooms"."capacity" IS NULL AND "occupancy_rooms"."capacity_confirmed"=0) OR (typeof("occupancy_rooms"."capacity")='integer' AND "occupancy_rooms"."capacity" BETWEEN 0 AND 200 AND "occupancy_rooms"."capacity_confirmed"=1)

property_import_batch_complete.name: property_import_batch_complete
property_import_batch_complete.value: "property_import_batches"."status" != 'completed' OR ("property_import_batches"."created_count" = "property_import_batches"."selected_count" AND "property_import_batches"."selected_count" > 0 AND "property_import_batches"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "property_import_batches"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "property_import_batches"."commit_token" IS NOT NULL)

property_import_created_result.name: property_import_created_result
property_import_created_result.value: ("property_import_rows"."result_status" = 'created' AND "property_import_rows"."property_id" IS NOT NULL AND "property_import_rows"."control_number" IS NOT NULL AND "property_import_rows"."control_number" > 0) OR ("property_import_rows"."result_status" != 'created' AND "property_import_rows"."property_id" IS NULL AND "property_import_rows"."control_number" IS NULL)

vehicle_year_valid.name: vehicle_year_valid
vehicle_year_valid.value: "vehicles"."year" IS NULL OR (typeof("vehicles"."year")='integer' AND "vehicles"."year" BETWEEN 1886 AND 9999)
